bug_info.bug_desc: In the readback check path in StPassThru, the alert output was asserted only when a readback mismatch was detected AND error_i was low. However, error_i indicates an incoming transaction error and may be asserted independently of the readback check, including when there is no active TL-UL transaction. As a result, a genuine readback mismatch could be silently missed whenever error_i happened to be high, violating the requirement that a readback mismatch must assert alert_o.
bug_info.fix_hint: Remove the `!error_i` term from the alert condition so that the readback mismatch is reported as an alert regardless of the state of `error_i`. The readback check should depend only on `rdback_chk_ok`.
